# Boolean Function Complexity Foundation

A complete exact atlas of every labeled Boolean function on one through four variables, with logical, algebraic, Fourier, query-complexity, symmetry, and relation-closure structure.

This neutral foundation contains 65,812 complete reconstructible objects and ships with no active target, conjecture, problem, or run history. Verification scope is disclosed in `verification/coverage.json`.

"""Exact finite Boolean-function substrate for the TheoX Study Library."""

from __future__ import annotations

import itertools
from collections.abc import Iterator
from functools import cache
from typing import Any

NUMERIC_DESCRIPTORS: dict[str, str] = {
    "arity": "Number of Boolean input variables.",
    "truth_table_mask": "Integer whose bit at input x is f(x), with x read in binary.",
    "truth_table_size": "Number 2^n of input assignments.",
    "satisfying_count": "Number of assignments x with f(x)=1.",
    "falsifying_count": "Number of assignments x with f(x)=0.",
    "essential_variable_count": "Number of coordinates whose flip changes f somewhere.",
    "algebraic_degree": "Maximum monomial degree in the algebraic normal form over F_2.",
    "anf_term_count": "Number of nonzero algebraic-normal-form coefficients.",
    "fourier_degree": "Largest support size of a nonzero Walsh-Fourier coefficient.",
    "walsh_max_abs": "Maximum absolute unnormalized Walsh coefficient.",
    "walsh_zero_count": "Number of zero Walsh coefficients.",
    "nonlinearity": "Minimum Hamming distance to an affine Boolean function.",
    "hamming_boundary_edges": "Number of hypercube edges across which f changes value.",
    "sensitivity_min": "Minimum point sensitivity over all inputs.",
    "sensitivity_max": "Maximum point sensitivity over all inputs.",
    "sensitivity_sum": "Sum of point sensitivities over all inputs.",
    "block_sensitivity": "Maximum number of pairwise-disjoint sensitive blocks at one input.",
    "certificate_complexity_0": "Maximum minimum certificate size over falsifying inputs.",
    "certificate_complexity_1": "Maximum minimum certificate size over satisfying inputs.",
    "decision_tree_depth": "Minimum worst-case depth of an exact deterministic decision tree.",
    "support_component_count": "Connected-component count of the satisfying subgraph of the hypercube.",
    "support_largest_component": "Largest satisfying-component order, or zero for empty support.",
    "zero_component_count": "Connected-component count of the falsifying subgraph of the hypercube.",
    "zero_largest_component": "Largest falsifying-component order, or zero for full support.",
    "variable_automorphism_count": "Number of input permutations preserving f.",
    "canalizing_variable_count": "Number of variables having an input value that forces a constant output.",
    "monotone_violation_count": "Number of oriented cube edges violating monotonicity.",
    "unate_variable_count": "Number of variables that are consistently nondecreasing or nonincreasing.",
}


PREDICATE_DESCRIPTORS: dict[str, str] = {
    "is_constant": "True exactly when f has one value on its complete domain.",
    "is_balanced": "True exactly when f has equally many zero and one values.",
    "is_zero_valid": "True exactly when f(0,...,0)=1.",
    "is_one_valid": "True exactly when f(1,...,1)=1.",
    "is_monotone": "True exactly when x<=y coordinatewise implies f(x)<=f(y).",
    "is_antitone": "True exactly when x<=y coordinatewise implies f(x)>=f(y).",
    "is_unate": "True when each variable has a consistent polarity.",
    "is_symmetric": "True when f depends only on the Hamming weight of its input.",
    "is_self_dual": "True when f(x)=1-f(not x) for every input x.",
    "is_affine_function": "True when the algebraic-normal-form degree is at most one.",
    "is_affine_relation": "True when the satisfying assignments form an affine F_2 subspace or are empty.",
    "is_horn_relation": "True when satisfying assignments are closed under coordinatewise meet.",
    "is_dual_horn_relation": "True when satisfying assignments are closed under coordinatewise join.",
    "is_canalizing": "True when at least one variable has a forcing input value.",
    "is_evasive": "True when exact deterministic decision-tree depth equals the arity.",
    "is_bent": "True when n is even and every Walsh coefficient has magnitude 2^(n/2).",
    "is_correlation_immune_order_1": "True when every singleton Walsh coefficient is zero.",
    "is_projection": "True when f equals one input coordinate.",
    "is_negated_projection": "True when f equals the complement of one input coordinate.",
    "has_isolated_satisfying_assignment": "True when the support contains an isolated hypercube vertex.",
    "has_isolated_falsifying_assignment": "True when the zero set contains an isolated hypercube vertex.",
}


def value(mask: int, assignment: int) -> int:
    return (mask >> assignment) & 1


def _anf(mask: int, arity: int) -> list[int]:
    coefficients = [value(mask, assignment) for assignment in range(1 << arity)]
    for bit in range(arity):
        for assignment in range(1 << arity):
            if assignment & (1 << bit):
                coefficients[assignment] ^= coefficients[assignment ^ (1 << bit)]
    return coefficients


def _walsh(mask: int, arity: int) -> list[int]:
    coefficients = [1 if not value(mask, assignment) else -1 for assignment in range(1 << arity)]
    step = 1
    while step < len(coefficients):
        for start in range(0, len(coefficients), 2 * step):
            for offset in range(step):
                left = coefficients[start + offset]
                right = coefficients[start + offset + step]
                coefficients[start + offset] = left + right
                coefficients[start + offset + step] = left - right
        step *= 2
    return coefficients


def _components(vertices: set[int], arity: int) -> tuple[int, int, bool]:
    unseen = set(vertices)
    sizes: list[int] = []
    isolated = False
    while unseen:
        root = unseen.pop()
        stack = [root]
        size = 0
        while stack:
            current = stack.pop()
            size += 1
            for bit in range(arity):
                neighbor = current ^ (1 << bit)
                if neighbor in unseen:
                    unseen.remove(neighbor)
                    stack.append(neighbor)
        sizes.append(size)
        isolated |= size == 1
    return len(sizes), max(sizes, default=0), isolated


def _certificate_size(mask: int, arity: int, assignment: int) -> int:
    expected = value(mask, assignment)
    full = (1 << arity) - 1
    for size in range(arity + 1):
        for chosen_bits in itertools.combinations(range(arity), size):
            chosen = sum(1 << bit for bit in chosen_bits)
            if all(
                value(mask, candidate) == expected
                for candidate in range(1 << arity)
                if ((candidate ^ assignment) & chosen) == 0
            ):
                return size
    return full.bit_count()


def _max_disjoint_family(blocks: list[int]) -> int:
    best = 0

    def search(index: int, used: int, count: int) -> None:
        nonlocal best
        if count + len(blocks) - index <= best:
            return
        if index == len(blocks):
            best = max(best, count)
            return
        search(index + 1, used, count)
        if not blocks[index] & used:
            search(index + 1, used | blocks[index], count + 1)

    search(0, 0, 0)
    return best


def _block_sensitivity(mask: int, arity: int) -> int:
    maximum = 0
    for assignment in range(1 << arity):
        blocks = [
            block
            for block in range(1, 1 << arity)
            if value(mask, assignment ^ block) != value(mask, assignment)
        ]
        maximum = max(maximum, _max_disjoint_family(blocks))
    return maximum


@cache
def _decision_tree_depth(outputs: tuple[int, ...], remaining: tuple[int, ...], assignments: tuple[int, ...]) -> int:
    first = outputs[assignments[0]]
    if all(outputs[assignment] == first for assignment in assignments):
        return 0
    return min(
        1 + max(
            _decision_tree_depth(outputs, tuple(bit for bit in remaining if bit != chosen), tuple(a for a in assignments if not a & (1 << chosen))),
            _decision_tree_depth(outputs, tuple(bit for bit in remaining if bit != chosen), tuple(a for a in assignments if a & (1 << chosen))),
        )
        for chosen in remaining
    )


def _permutation_image(assignment: int, permutation: tuple[int, ...]) -> int:
    image = 0
    for destination, source in enumerate(permutation):
        image |= ((assignment >> source) & 1) << destination
    return image


def _relation_closed(mask: int, arity: int, operation: str) -> bool:
    support = [assignment for assignment in range(1 << arity) if value(mask, assignment)]
    if operation == "affine":
        if not support:
            return True
        base = support[0]
        translated = {assignment ^ base for assignment in support}
        return all(left ^ right in translated for left in translated for right in translated)
    combine = (lambda left, right: left & right) if operation == "meet" else (lambda left, right: left | right)
    return all(value(mask, combine(left, right)) for left in support for right in support)


def function_record(arity: int, mask: int) -> dict[str, Any]:
    size = 1 << arity
    outputs = tuple(value(mask, assignment) for assignment in range(size))
    support = {assignment for assignment, output in enumerate(outputs) if output}
    zero_set = set(range(size)) - support
    anf = _anf(mask, arity)
    walsh = _walsh(mask, arity)
    sensitivities = [
        sum(outputs[assignment] != outputs[assignment ^ (1 << bit)] for bit in range(arity))
        for assignment in range(size)
    ]
    essential = [
        any(outputs[assignment] != outputs[assignment ^ (1 << bit)] for assignment in range(size))
        for bit in range(arity)
    ]
    nondecreasing = []
    nonincreasing = []
    violations = 0
    for bit in range(arity):
        down = [assignment for assignment in range(size) if not assignment & (1 << bit)]
        nondecreasing.append(all(outputs[x] <= outputs[x | (1 << bit)] for x in down))
        nonincreasing.append(all(outputs[x] >= outputs[x | (1 << bit)] for x in down))
        violations += sum(outputs[x] > outputs[x | (1 << bit)] for x in down)
    canalizing_variables = 0
    for bit in range(arity):
        if any(
            len({outputs[x] for x in range(size) if ((x >> bit) & 1) == bit_value}) == 1
            for bit_value in (0, 1)
        ):
            canalizing_variables += 1
    support_components, support_largest, support_isolated = _components(support, arity)
    zero_components, zero_largest, zero_isolated = _components(zero_set, arity)
    cert_zero = max((_certificate_size(mask, arity, x) for x in zero_set), default=0)
    cert_one = max((_certificate_size(mask, arity, x) for x in support), default=0)
    depth = _decision_tree_depth(outputs, tuple(range(arity)), tuple(range(size)))
    automorphisms = sum(
        all(outputs[x] == outputs[_permutation_image(x, permutation)] for x in range(size))
        for permutation in itertools.permutations(range(arity))
    )
    symmetric = all(
        len({outputs[x] for x in range(size) if x.bit_count() == weight}) <= 1
        for weight in range(arity + 1)
    )
    self_dual = all(outputs[x] == 1 - outputs[(size - 1) ^ x] for x in range(size))
    algebraic_degree = max((index.bit_count() for index, coefficient in enumerate(anf) if coefficient), default=0)
    fourier_degree = max((index.bit_count() for index, coefficient in enumerate(walsh) if coefficient), default=0)
    walsh_max_abs = max(abs(coefficient) for coefficient in walsh)
    satisfying_count = len(support)
    is_constant = satisfying_count in {0, size}
    is_monotone = all(nondecreasing)
    is_antitone = all(nonincreasing)
    is_projection = any(all(outputs[x] == ((x >> bit) & 1) for x in range(size)) for bit in range(arity))
    is_negated_projection = any(all(outputs[x] == 1 - ((x >> bit) & 1) for x in range(size)) for bit in range(arity))
    return {
        "object_id": f"boolean-function:n={arity}:mask={mask:0{size // 4}x}",
        "object_label": f"Boolean function n={arity}, mask=0x{mask:0{size // 4}x}",
        "object_type": "finite_boolean_function",
        "object_representation": f"arity={arity};truth_table_mask={mask}",
        "family": f"arity_{arity}",
        "arity": arity,
        "truth_table_mask": mask,
        "truth_table_size": size,
        "satisfying_count": satisfying_count,
        "falsifying_count": size - satisfying_count,
        "essential_variable_count": sum(essential),
        "algebraic_degree": algebraic_degree,
        "anf_term_count": sum(anf),
        "fourier_degree": fourier_degree,
        "walsh_max_abs": walsh_max_abs,
        "walsh_zero_count": sum(coefficient == 0 for coefficient in walsh),
        "nonlinearity": size // 2 - walsh_max_abs // 2,
        "hamming_boundary_edges": sum(sensitivities) // 2,
        "sensitivity_min": min(sensitivities),
        "sensitivity_max": max(sensitivities),
        "sensitivity_sum": sum(sensitivities),
        "block_sensitivity": _block_sensitivity(mask, arity),
        "certificate_complexity_0": cert_zero,
        "certificate_complexity_1": cert_one,
        "decision_tree_depth": depth,
        "support_component_count": support_components,
        "support_largest_component": support_largest,
        "zero_component_count": zero_components,
        "zero_largest_component": zero_largest,
        "variable_automorphism_count": automorphisms,
        "canalizing_variable_count": canalizing_variables,
        "monotone_violation_count": violations,
        "unate_variable_count": sum(up or down for up, down in zip(nondecreasing, nonincreasing, strict=True)),
        "is_constant": is_constant,
        "is_balanced": satisfying_count * 2 == size,
        "is_zero_valid": bool(outputs[0]),
        "is_one_valid": bool(outputs[-1]),
        "is_monotone": is_monotone,
        "is_antitone": is_antitone,
        "is_unate": all(up or down for up, down in zip(nondecreasing, nonincreasing, strict=True)),
        "is_symmetric": symmetric,
        "is_self_dual": self_dual,
        "is_affine_function": algebraic_degree <= 1,
        "is_affine_relation": _relation_closed(mask, arity, "affine"),
        "is_horn_relation": _relation_closed(mask, arity, "meet"),
        "is_dual_horn_relation": _relation_closed(mask, arity, "join"),
        "is_canalizing": canalizing_variables > 0,
        "is_evasive": depth == arity,
        "is_bent": arity % 2 == 0 and all(abs(coefficient) == 1 << (arity // 2) for coefficient in walsh),
        "is_correlation_immune_order_1": all(walsh[1 << bit] == 0 for bit in range(arity)),
        "is_projection": is_projection,
        "is_negated_projection": is_negated_projection,
        "has_isolated_satisfying_assignment": support_isolated,
        "has_isolated_falsifying_assignment": zero_isolated,
    }


def build_records(max_arity: int = 4) -> Iterator[dict[str, Any]]:
    if not 1 <= max_arity <= 4:
        raise ValueError("max_arity must be between 1 and 4")
    for arity in range(1, max_arity + 1):
        for mask in range(1 << (1 << arity)):
            yield function_record(arity, mask)


def expected_object_count(max_arity: int = 4) -> int:
    return sum(1 << (1 << arity) for arity in range(1, max_arity + 1))

abbrev BooleanFunction (n : Nat) := (Fin n → Bool) → Bool

def complement {n : Nat} (f : BooleanFunction n) : BooleanFunction n :=
  fun x => !(f x)

def IsZeroValid {n : Nat} (f : BooleanFunction n) : Prop :=
  f (fun _ => false) = true

def IsOneValid {n : Nat} (f : BooleanFunction n) : Prop :=
  f (fun _ => true) = true

theorem complement_apply {n : Nat} (f : BooleanFunction n) (x : Fin n → Bool) :
    complement f x = !(f x) := rfl

theorem complement_involutive {n : Nat} (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    complement (complement f) = f := by
  funext x
  simp [complement]

theorem complement_zero_valid_iff {n : Nat} (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    IsZeroValid (complement f) ↔ f (fun _ => false) = false := by
  simp [IsZeroValid, complement]

theorem complement_one_valid_iff {n : Nat} (f : BooleanFunction n) :
    IsOneValid (complement f) ↔ f (fun _ => true) = false := by
  simp [IsOneValid, complement]
